name: Encantadia: Echoes of the Gems
imageAlt: Encantadia: Echoes of the Gems Java Swing pixel-art battle screen and Tower of Trials interface
summary: An interactive Java Swing fighting game built with strict OOP principles and JDBC state management.
description: Encantadia: Echoes of the Gems is an interactive fighting game featuring custom Java Swing screens, elemental Sang'gre abilities, a 7-tier Tower of Trials gauntlet, and JDBC-backed state persistence.
techStackContext: Utilized Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) for robust state management and Java Swing for GUI rendering. Led the team in structuring complex game logic using strict Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
